item.title: Youth who attended music concert at Colombo Port City found dead
item.description: A male body has been discovered while floating in the sea near the Colombo Port City, police said. MORE..

item.title: Govt launches special programme to safeguard tourists and migrant workers amid Middle East crisis
item.description: In view of the unrest that has arisen in the Middle East and the Gulf region, the Government has launched a series of special operations to look into the safety and welfare of foreign tourists currently in Sri Lanka, as well as to ensure the protection and well-being of Sri Lankan migrant workers overseas. MORE..

item.title: Israel strikes Beirut s southern suburbs after Hezbollah attacks
item.description: Israel carried out heavy airstrikes on the Hezbollah-controlled southern suburbs of Beirut on Monday, after the Iran-backed group launched missiles and drones towards Israel in retaliation for the killing of Iran s Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei. MORE..

item.title: US, Arab nations slam Tehran s drone, missiles strikes after US-Israel joint military action on Iran
item.description: The United States and six Arab nations on Monday issued a strongly worded statement condemning Iran s recent missile and drone attacks across West Asia, calling them indiscriminate , reckless , and a dangerous escalation that threatens regional stability. MORE..

item.title: GMOA withdraws from Arogya Project, cites lack of transparency and political motives
item.description: The Government Medical Officers Association (GMOA) has announced that it will withdraw from the “Arogya” project launched by the Ministry of Health with effect from today (02). MORE..

item.title: Iraqi militia claims drone attack targeting US troops in Baghdad
item.description: An Iraqi Shiite militia claimed a drone attack Monday targeting U.S. troops at the airport in Iraq s capital, Baghdad, further widening the retaliation over the killing of Iran s Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. MORE..

item.title: As Israel bombs Tehran, series of blasts over Jerusalem
item.description: A series of loud blasts were heard above Jerusalem following sirens on Sunday evening, AFP journalists reported, after the Israeli military said it had detected missiles launched from Iran. MORE..

item.title: Iran FM- Oman events not intentional; military units now independent and isolated, acting on prior directives
item.description: Iran s Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi has said that recent incidents in Oman were not deliberate, stressing that Tehran did not intend to widen the conflict across the Gulf. MORE..

item.title: Funds allocated for provincial school infrastructure; PM urges submission of development requests
item.description: Prime Minister Harini Amarasuriya stated that the necessary financial allocations for the development of infrastructure in provincial schools have been provided to all provinces. MORE..

item.title: 115 flights between Sri Lanka and Middle East cancelled; Cancellations continue today
item.description: All flights from Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) to the Middle East scheduled for today (01 March) have also been cancelled due to the ongoing conflict in the region. MORE..
